day_shape: 71 items: Qatar says US-Iran reviewing mediation proposals while Jerusalem Post sources call talks stalled, Khamenei warns foreign powers belong 'at the bottom' of the Persian Gulf, two more Isfahan protesters hanged, heavy IRIB/Defa Press 13 Aban mobilisation; nothing from UK Parliament, State Department or OFAC.

threads.label: US-Iran mediation track and war footing
threads.summary: Qatar said Washington and Tehran are reviewing mediation proposals, while Jerusalem Post sources described talks as stalled and a senior Iranian official told Reuters the sides remained far from a deal. SNSC Secretary Rezaei said America's response on Iran's seven conditions was 'not convincing' and tied any Strait of Hormuz opening to full compliance.

threads.label: Threat signalling and chemical-weapons warning
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Israel told Washington its intelligence suggests Iran may use chemical weapons, though some US officials doubt the reporting, while CENTCOM posted M777 live-fire imagery from the Middle East. Khamenei's office posted that foreign powers interfering in the Persian Gulf belong 'at the bottom of its waters' and that threats must be met 'without geographical limitation'; Basij deputy commander Qureishi claimed US soldiers will no longer be safe anywhere.

threads.label: 13 Aban mobilisation cycle
threads.summary: IRGC, Army, Expediency Council chairman Amoli Larijani and Education Minister Kazemi issued statements marking 13 Aban as 'National Day of Struggle Against Global Arrogance', with Tehran's Islamic Propaganda Organization announcing a 9 a.m. march from Palestine Square to the former US embassy. IRIB and Defa Press carried conference remarks from Foreign Ministry spokesperson Baghaeian, Red Crescent head Kolivand (citing 80,000 Palestinians killed) and President Pezeshkian blaming US and Israeli actions for regional instability.

threads.label: Iran-Egypt diplomatic contact
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported a phone call between Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi and Egyptian counterpart Badr Abdelatty discussing regional developments and concerns over renewed military action. Egypt's foreign ministry spokesman Nader Zaki was cited via Al-Youm Al-Sabea as confirming the call.

threads.label: Executions and domestic repression
threads.summary: Iran International reported that Amirhossein Maleki and Amirhossein Ebrahimi were hanged in Isfahan over January 2026 protests, with a source saying Maleki, 20, was subjected to a mock execution after retracting a confession he said was extracted under torture. Exiled prince Reza Pahlavi, arriving in Brussels, urged European governments to end 'appeasement' of Tehran.

threads.label: Hezbollah, Syria and Lebanon realignments
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah-appointed Labor Minister Mohammad Haidar visited Damascus with three other Lebanese ministers — the first such formal reception since Assad's fall — while separate analysis described Syria's new government targeting Hezbollah networks and sectarian tensions over Hezbollah's arms. Defa Press carried a Hezbollah statement denying any role in destabilising Syria.

threads.label: Oil routes and Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Aramco CEO Amin Nasser said the company is exploring expansion of a crude pipeline that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz, and carried analysis that Turkish ports are handling increased oil flows. A separate explainer examined the IRGC's use of Qeshm Island and repeated US strikes there.

events.title: An army Humvee stolen from a base in southern Israel last week was located by police officers this evening in a community near the Gaza Strip. No suspects have been detained yet in the case.
